tagline: A reviving Indian Ocean gateway with a long resort coast in reach.
summary: Colombo anchors Sri Lanka's west coast — Port City Colombo's new waterfront, the southern resort belt (Bentota, Galle, Mirissa) and the Indian Ocean position toward the Maldives. Pioneer II suits the Colombo waterfront and near-coast resort hops; Quanta-LR's hybrid range opens the longer southern-coast corridors.
